description: An experimental feedback distortion: the input is amplified, distorted, and fed back at a frequency of your choosing

params.text: Switches the distortion and the feedback on and off
Amplifies the input, working as a compressor and limiter on it
Sets the amount of distortion applied to the input
Sets the level of the distorted part of the output
Mixes in the feedback, from very little at the minimum to a howl at the maximum
Sets the target frequency of the feedback, which can lift that frequency or work like a filter, depending on the input
Limits the output to 10 volts peak to peak, whether or not the distortion and feedback are switched on, and lights red while it is limiting
Clears the internal buffers, which restarts processing after the feedback has blown the output out

inputs.text: Modulates the amplification of the input
Modulates the level of the distorted part of the output
Modulates the amount of feedback in the output
Sets the target frequency of the feedback, at a volt per octave added to the knob

outputs.text: The distorted signal and its feedback

notes: every CV input is calibrated to -5 to +5V and is added to its knob, with the result clamped to the range of that knob
the distortion and the feedback are applied only while Pig Power! is switched on

inputs.5: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
